messages:
Jane (Support): FYI — Acme reported promo code SUMMER50 landed on their Hosted account (tenant 12345) but they wanted it applied to their Dedicated reserved sku dedicated-p4-gpu.

Emily (Acct): Customer says they signed up for a Dedicated trial; invoice id inv_8723 attached.

Jane (Support): billing-bot shows the grant event:

billing-bot: promo_grant event: promo=SUMMER50 tenant=12345 target=hosted sku=hosted-standard amount=5000 ts=1849499900

Miguel (Billing): Got it. Can you paste the promo id and tenant? I need to check the ledger and whether it was mis-routed by the promo-routing rule.

Jane (Support): tenant=12345, promo=SUMMER50, order=inv_8723. Also customer contact: lucas@acme.com. They're blocked from committing to Dedicated until this is resolved.

Ben (Eng): Quick check — was the promo created with a target tag? If rule matched 'any' it may default to hosted. I can run a safe reassign script, but prefer creating equivalent credit on Dedicated and voiding Hosted credit to keep audit.

Miguel (Billing): Preferred approach: create credit on dedicated-sku equal to amount and revoke hosted credit. I'll run procedure and log ticket BILL-4321. Reassign ETA ~10m.

Ben (Eng): If you want to run the resync I have this command to recreate the allocation (dry-run first):

```
./billing/tools/alloc-promocode --promo SUMMER50 --tenant 12345 --target dedicated-p4-gpu --dry-run
```

Miguel (Billing): Running dry-run now... :eyes:

billing-bot: dry-run result: would_create_credit tenant=12345 target=dedicated-p4-gpu amount=5000

Miguel (Billing): Dry-run good. Reassigning for real, creating credit and voiding hosted credit. I'll post tx ids when done.

Jane (Support): Please cc customer when done. I'll follow up.

billing-bot: txn=tx_998877 created_credit tenant=12345 amount=5000 target=dedicated-p4-gpu

billing-bot: txn=tx_998878 voided_credit tenant=12345 amount=5000 target=hosted-standard

Miguel (Billing): Done. Confirmed with audit log and emailed Lucas. Ticket BILL-4321. :thumbsup:

Emily (Acct): Customer replied, all good. Closing loop.

Jane (Support): Thanks team. Marking thread resolved.
